steps.title: How it works
steps.intro: We spot the fault before you do. With the manufacturer's app alone, you often find it on the bill.

items.title: We connect to your inverter
items.body: Whatever its brand, with no hardware to install in most cases. You simply give us access to your manufacturer app.

items.title: AI checks it every day
items.body: It compares your production with the weather and nearby installations, and spots outright faults as well as slow declines.

items.title: We step in within 2 days
items.body: A technician from Saint-Laurent-du-Var comes out for free, diagnoses and repairs. You follow everything on WhatsApp.

warranty.title: Your inverter breaks down? You have nothing to do.
warranty.body: One inverter in three fails within its first 15 years. Claiming the warranty often takes weeks of back-and-forth with the manufacturer. We handle it end to end.
warranty.source: Source: Bern University of Applied Sciences, study of 2,121 residential inverters (pv magazine, 2023).
steps: Warranty claim prepared and sent to the manufacturer
Replacement follow-up until the hardware is delivered
warranty.motto: The warranty pays for the part. We do everything else.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.more: Another question? The technical team answers on

items.question: Can I cancel whenever I want?
items.answer: After 12 months, at any time with one month's notice, directly from your customer area.

items.question: Is my inverter compatible?
items.answer: Every brand is supported. If yours is not connected yet, we do it within 30 days.

items.question: Do I need to install any hardware?
items.answer: In most cases, no. You give us access to your manufacturer's app and we connect to your inverter remotely.

items.question: My installer has disappeared. Can you take over?
items.answer: Yes. A 30-minute video audit with a technician (€49.99), then we take over the follow-up. We also finish the pending paperwork: Consuel, grid connection.

items.question: How is this different from the manufacturer's warranty?
items.answer: The warranty pays for the part. We do everything else: diagnosis, claim, call-out and installation.

items.question: I do not live in the 06, 83 or 13.
items.answer: Care Connect covers you anywhere in France: 24/7 AI monitoring, alerts and a monthly report. If it breaks down, a partner installer near you steps in.

items.question: Until when is the founder price available?
items.answer: Subscribe before 31 December 2026 and pay €19.99 incl. VAT per month instead of €24.99, guaranteed for 2 years. Subscriptions are billed from 1 January 2027.
